headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 20, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. Dingler hit a home run (17) on a fly ball to center field, contributing to the Tigers' win. The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory, led by Sal Stewart's 2 hits and 6 RBIs. The Toronto Blue Jays secured an 8-6 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win and Daulton Varsho leading the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Adley Rutschman, catcher for the Baltimore Orioles, has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, effective retroactive to June 19, 2026. Other notable injuries include Blake Treinen (Los Angeles Dodgers, right elbow inflammation), Isiah Kiner-Falefa (Boston Red Sox, left forearm inflammation), Mark Leiter Jr. (Athletics, right hip impingement), Michael Soroka (Arizona Diamondbacks, left glute strain), Jordan Lawlar (Arizona Diamondbacks, right hamstring strain), and Ryne Nelson (Arizona Diamondbacks, strained right elbow).

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Washington Nationals traded RHP Tyler Schoff to the Atlanta Braves. The Houston Astros traded RHP Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for 1B Cameron Sisneros. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded SS Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Atlanta Braves traded RHP Hunter Stratton to the Pittsburgh Pirates for C Joey Bart. The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash.
